_note: Canonical location ~/.claude/skills/idea/contexts/claude-code-proxy.json is outside sandbox; this mirror lives inside the project.
target_users: Claude Code developers who want to route Anthropic-format requests to non-Anthropic backends (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Google Gemini/Vertex) while retaining the Claude Code CLI experience.
problem_statement: Claude Code and other Anthropic-SDK clients are hardwired to the Anthropic API surface, but developers often need (or must) use alternative backends — Azure OpenAI for enterprise compliance, OpenAI directly, Google Gemini for cost, or self-hosted open models — without rewriting their tooling. A drop-in, Anthropic-compatible gateway is needed that translates requests/responses bidirectionally, handles streaming, tool use, and multi-provider fallback, while enforcing security constraints (pinned LiteLLM versions, supply-chain policy).

tech_stack.hosting: localhost:8082 via uvicorn, LaunchAgents for login autostart

constraints.cve_compliance: Must be >=1.77.7 to mitigate CVE-2024-6825 (RCE) and CVE-2024-8984 (DoS)
constraints.attribution: no AI/Claude attribution in external commits/PRs

architecture_scan.azure_deployment_map: JSON env var mapping OpenAI model names to Azure deployment names (22 entries)

functional: Route Anthropic-SDK requests to an arbitrary backend transparently
Map tier names (haiku/sonnet/opus) to concrete provider deployments
Provide graceful fallback when primary provider is unavailable
emotional: Confidence that credentials are not exfiltrated via compromised dependencies
Frictionless switching of backend providers without touching the CLI
social: Enable enterprise use of Claude Code inside Azure-only organizations
Allow cost-conscious teams to use Gemini without abandoning Anthropic tooling

discover.scope_statement: A local FastAPI proxy on port 8082 that presents the Anthropic /v1/messages surface to Claude Code and other Anthropic-SDK clients, translates requests and responses via LiteLLM to a configurable backend, supports streaming and tool-use, enforces a strict LiteLLM version pin for supply-chain safety, and exposes management tooling via a Swift menu bar app, a bash TUI, and a CLI. It does NOT host or train models, does not serve multi-tenant traffic, and is not intended for public-internet exposure.

personas.name: Enterprise Claude Code Developer
personas.need: Use Claude Code with Azure OpenAI deployments for compliance
personas.pain: Claude Code only speaks to api.anthropic.com by default

personas.name: Multi-Provider Power User
personas.need: Switch between GPT-4.1, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5 Pro per task
personas.pain: Each provider has a different SDK and tooling ecosystem

personas.name: Security-Conscious Operator
personas.need: Run a proxy whose dependency chain is audited and pinned
personas.pain: LiteLLM has had active supply-chain attacks (1.82.7/1.82.8)

define.positioning_statement: For Claude Code users who need backend flexibility, Claude Code Proxy is a local Anthropic-API-compatible gateway that routes requests to Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic via LiteLLM.

hypotheses.statement: A 1:1 Anthropic<->LiteLLM translation layer can preserve streaming + tool-use fidelity
Tier-name remapping (haiku/sonnet/opus) gives users a stable mental model
Azure fallback improves UX when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing or returns 404
A menu bar app lowers the cost of switching active model at runtime
Pinning LiteLLM <1.82.0 is sufficient to mitigate TeamPCP supply-chain attack

market_size.value: Internal single-user tool; estimated ~10k Claude Code users globally who would benefit

testing.manual_qa: ccp-litellm troubleshoot, menu bar live status
